network_status.network: Relazione IFFI - evento alluvionale 2003 in Valcanale e Canal del Ferro
network_status.summary_it: La relazione regionale documenta l'evento estremo del 29 agosto 2003, le portate eccezionali del Fella e dei tributari e i processi di erosione e trasporto solido, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata numerica attribuibile al ponte di Pietratagliata. I valori pluviometrici non vengono trasformati in deflusso.
network_status.summary_en: The regional report documents the extreme 29 August 2003 event, exceptional flows in the Fella and its tributaries, and erosion and sediment-transport processes, but publishes no numerical stage or discharge attributable to the Pietratagliata bridge. Rainfall values are not converted into runoff.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
